_comment: Recommended HTTP response headers for the deployed frontend (Phase 16). Replace {API_ORIGIN} with the API's origin, e.g. https://api.example.com. The script hash belongs to the inline theme script in index.html; tests/e2e/security-headers.spec.ts fails if they drift apart. style-src allows 'unsafe-inline' because Radix (dialogs, scroll lock) and other UI libraries inject style elements and attributes at runtime, and a static host can't issue per-request nonces; scripts stay strict ('self' + one hash, no eval).
Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'sha256-KkXs7okNWJLe1/xSFtE+IJc4NWwXKwuxyB+gnfAVhms='; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' {API_ORIGIN}; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'
